6_research_qa_notes:
**Findings forced to Provisional:**
- F-P01 and F-P02: Forced to Provisional because direct fetch of earthweb.com/patreon-statistics/ returned 403; snippets obtained from search engine index only.
- F-P03: Forced to Provisional because direct fetch of patreon.com/search returned 403; snippet obtained from search engine index via research assistant.
- F-P04 and F-P05: Forced to Provisional because Chrome Web Store URLs were not directly fetched by lead agent; snippets from search engine index.
- F-P06 and F-P07: Forced to Provisional because URLs were fetched by research assistant only; lead agent did not independently verify.
- F-P08: Forced to Provisional because graphtreon.com/top-patreon-creators/podcasts was fetched by research assistant only; lead agent did not independently verify.
- F-P09: Forced to Provisional because apify.com URL was not directly fetched; snippet from search engine index.
- F-P10: Forced to Provisional because sodaspoon.com URL was fetched by research assistant only.

**Findings degraded to could_not_verify:**
- F-X01: Patreon /explore page blocked (403), JS-rendered placeholder content only.
- F-X02: All 17 Patreon /explore sub-pages blocked (403).
- F-X03: Individual creator tier prices inaccessible.
- F-X04: Placeit templates page blocked (403), only fragmented search snippets available.
- F-X06: Fiverr category page is ambiguous URL per protocol.
- F-X07: Graphtreon video category page returned PERMISSIONS_ERROR.

**Findings degraded due to URL not fixable:**
- None. All URLs in Parts 1–4 have fixable URLs.

**Multi-speaker pages split into separate findings:**
- F-P08: Graphtreon /top-patreon-creators/podcasts contains multiple creator listings. Three creators' data points were included in a single finding rather than split, as they represent ranked entries in the same list layout rather than distinct speakers. This is a borderline case; splitting into 3–5 separate findings would have inflated the output.

**Truncated or partial sources:**
- Backlinko article (F-07, F-08) was truncated at approximately 8,000 tokens during fetch; key statistics sections were captured but later sections (e.g., employees) may have been cut.
- Graphtreon homepage (used for PC-03 comparison) was truncated; aggregate stats section was captured.

**source_type ambiguities:**
- graphtreon.com pages classified as database_profile (Graphtreon is a third-party database of Patreon creator profiles). Could also arguably be classified as search_results_page for ranking pages.
- creatormetrics.io classified as product_listing (SaaS product landing page). Not a perfect fit for any allowed type; product_listing is closest.
- sodaspoon.com/blogs/agency/patreon-agency classified as blog. URL path contains "/blogs/" and content is advisory/marketing in nature.
- patreon.com/search classified as search_results_page. This is Patreon's own search interface, which displays category filter labels.

**Coverage gaps where findings expected but not found:**
- **Patreon membership tier prices:** No individual tier price data was obtainable. All Patreon creator pages are JS-rendered and blocked (403). No third-party source provided verbatim tier price listings with creator names and tier structures. This is a significant coverage gap for the "price ranges" component of this shard.
- **Patreon explore page categories:** The actual categories displayed on Patreon's own explore interface could not be observed. Only six category labels from the /search page index and the Graphtreon taxonomy are available as proxies.
- **Patreon commerce/digital product listings:** No evidence of one-time product purchases, commerce listings, or digital download storefronts was found through accessible pages. Patreon's "digital product sales" feature (referenced in D1 help center material routed to F-X05) could not be observed directly.
- **Discount patterns, review counts, geographic availability filters:** None observed on any accessible page.
- **Graphtreon /top-patreon-creators/video:** Fetch failed; video-category-specific top creator data is missing.

**Data discrepancy noted (not in findings per protocol):**
- Graphtreon homepage (graphtreon.com/) shows 284,835 paid creators / $23,743,704 monthly payouts (fetched April 14, 2026), while /patreon-stats shows 325,425 paid creators / $25,443,110 monthly payouts (fetched same date). This discrepancy was observed across two pages on the same site fetched in parallel. No interpretation is offered. Findings F-01 and F-02 use the /patreon-stats page figures.
- Backlinko (Feb. 25, 2026) reports 286,287 paid creators citing Graphtreon; Graphtreon /patreon-stats (April 14, 2026) shows 325,425. This difference is noted without interpretation.

**Cases where input could not be decomposed without interpretation:**
- None.
